aboutPage.title: About the project
aboutPage.subtitle: BuildConnect — marketplace for Kazakhstan's construction industry
aboutPage.intro: BuildConnect brings customers, contractors, and suppliers together on one platform: companies publish profiles and portfolios, list services and materials, and customers find contractors through the catalog, tenders, and direct chat requests.

customers.label: Customers
customers.text: — find contractors, submit requests, publish tenders, and manage conversations in one place.

contractors.label: Contractors
contractors.text: — represent their company, showcase projects, respond to tenders, and receive orders.

suppliers.label: Suppliers
suppliers.text: — list construction materials and communicate with buyers through built-in chat.

goal.title: Our goal
goal.text: Make finding reliable construction partners transparent and convenient: less chaos in messenger threads, more structure — requests, deal context, and conversation history in your account.

termsPage.title: Terms of use
termsPage.subtitle: Rules for using the BuildConnect platform
termsPage.published: Published: May 15, 2026. By using the BuildConnect website, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree — please do not use the service.

general.title: 1. General provisions
general.text: BuildConnect is an information platform for publishing company profiles, services, materials, tenders, and messaging between users. The administration provides the technical means for publishing and communication but is not a party to transactions between users.

registration.title: 2. Registration and account
registration.text: You agree to provide accurate information when registering and to keep your profile up to date. You are responsible for safeguarding access to your account and for all actions performed under your login.

content.title: 3. User content
content.text: By publishing information about your company, services, materials, tenders, reviews, and chat messages, you confirm that you have the right to publish such content and that you do not violate the laws of the Republic of Kazakhstan, third-party rights, or platform rules. Prohibited: false information, spam, insults, fraud, publishing others' personal data without consent.

deals.title: 4. Transactions between users
deals.text: Payment terms, deadlines, scope of work, and liability are determined directly between the customer and the contractor. BuildConnect does not guarantee the quality of services, deliveries, or fulfillment of participants' obligations and does not act as an intermediary in payments unless explicitly agreed otherwise.

reviews.title: 5. Reviews and ratings
reviews.text: Reviews must reflect real interaction experience. The administration may hide or remove reviews and materials that violate the rules or the law.

liability.title: 6. Limitation of liability
liability.text: The service is provided "as is". We strive to keep the platform running reliably but are not liable for access interruptions, data loss caused by third parties, or losses arising from agreements between users.

changes.title: 7. Changes to terms
changes.text: We may update these terms. The current version is always available on this page. Continued use of the service after changes are published means you agree to the updated terms.

contacts.title: 8. Contacts
contacts.text: For questions about these terms and platform operation, contact us via <contactsLink>Contacts</contactsLink> or at <emailLink>support@buildconnect.kz</emailLink>.

helpPage.title: Help
helpPage.subtitle: Frequently asked questions about using BuildConnect

gettingStarted.title: Getting started
gettingStarted.text: Register, complete your profile (name, phone, city), choose your primary scenario during registration, and on the next step — "create a company" or "just ordering for now". Role and onboarding choices are hints, not hard restrictions: anyone can create tenders, and any user can add a company to the catalog via company creation or the My companies section in your account.

roles.title: Roles and capabilities
roles.intro: The main rules are the same for everyone: you cannot send a request to yourself and you cannot buy your own product or service. To respond to a tender you need at least one company of your own.
roles.footnote: ¹ Without a company in your profile. ² Only if the tender is "Open", not yours, and your company is selected. ³ Including responses to your tenders — if you have no company, requests go directly to your profile.

rows.action: Request to a company from the catalog
Order a service / buy a material

search.title: Search and catalog
search.text: On the home page and in the site header you can search companies, services, materials, and tenders — the system will redirect you to the right section. The <catalogLink>company catalog</catalogLink> has filters by city and category. Suppliers, contractors, and customers can message companies from the catalog on equal terms.

requests.title: Requests and chat
requests.main: Buttons "Send request", "Order service", "Buy product", or "Respond to tender" create a dialog and open chat immediately. Conversations and statuses are in your <profileLink>account</profileLink>, "Requests and chats" tab. The first message includes a unified "Source" block (catalog, services, materials, tender, or video showcase) with a link to the listing.
requests.outgoing: Outgoing requests show the company or recipient user. Incoming ones show the customer; responses to your tender without a company from the author go to their profile personally (not the company page).
requests.templates: Contract templates (signed-in only): in your profile — "Contract templates"; documents can be downloaded as .docx and .pdf. Send the signed file to your counterparty via the paperclip button in the request chat (up to 20 MB).

tenders.title: Tenders
tenders.text: Any signed-in user can create a tender — specify task type, city, budget, and deadline. All statuses are visible on the showcase (open, in progress, closed); responses are only possible on open ones. Company verification is not required to publish a tender — it is required for the catalog, services/materials showcase, and responding to others' tenders on behalf of a company. The author sees the "Responses" block on the tender page and in profile → "My tenders": participant list, "Chat", "Accept" (tender moves to "In progress"), and "Close tender" buttons. You can manually move an open tender to "In progress" only after at least one response; without responses the option is unavailable. After "Accept", "Open" status is not available manually — use the "Accept responses again" button to clear the selected contractor and accept responses again. List — in the Tenders section.

reviews.title: Ratings and reviews
reviews.rating: Stars in the catalog and on the company page are calculated only from real user reviews after completed deals. If there are no reviews yet — "No reviews" is shown.
reviews.leave: Only a customer can leave a review after a completed request with the company: in chat click "Complete request", then "Leave review", or open the company page. One review per company per user.

verification.title: Company verification
verification.process: After creating a company, the owner uploads documents (registration certificate, representative ID, and power of attorney if needed) in the "Verification" section in company management and clicks "Submit for review". Only verified companies with the "Verified" badge appear in the catalog. The same rule applies to services, materials, and showcase videos; authors' tenders do not depend on verification.
verification.timing: Document review is performed by platform moderators. It usually takes one to several business days. You can track application status in the "Verification" section.

reports.title: Reports
reports.text: The "Report" button is on the company page and on others' tenders. The report is sent to the moderation team for review — select a reason and add a comment if needed.

companyManagement.title: Company management
companyManagement.text: The company owner edits the profile, portfolio, services, materials, showcase videos, and responds to requests. Management section — from the company page after sign-in. You can create a company with any role in profile settings.

troubleshooting.title: Can't sign in or load data
troubleshooting.text: Check your internet connection and refresh the page. If the error persists, contact us via the <contactsLink>Contacts</contactsLink> page — include your account email and a brief description of the problem.
